R1.description: Reversible application behavior without auth, tenancy, persistence, or deployment changes

R2.description: Migrations, GraphQL contracts, ABAC, tenant scoping, sensitive data, audit, external integrations

R3.description: Destructive migrations, production data access, retention or legal policy, infrastructure deletion

independence_levels.I1: Fresh verifier session, separate worktree, immutable SHA, report-only review
independence_levels.I2: I1 plus different provider or specialist review where practical
independence_levels.I3: I2 plus staging, operations or security review, canary, and rollback evidence

control_channel.target_storage: protected factory-control/<work-package> ref or external attestation store
control_channel.rule: Do not commit attestation updates onto the implementation PR after the subject SHA is frozen.
